how.title: How it works
how.step1.title: Choose a package
how.step1.text: Sign in with Google, pick a package and confirm your order. You receive a unique order ID.
how.step2.title: Pay via WhatsApp
how.step2.text: Message the administrator with your pre-filled order details, agree the payment method and send your proof of payment in the chat.
how.step3.title: Track your order
how.step3.text: The administrator verifies payment by hand and updates your order. Follow each step from your dashboard.
benefits.title: Why customers choose us
benefits.b1.title: Human-verified payments
benefits.b1.text: Every payment is checked by a person. Nothing is ever approved automatically.
benefits.b2.title: Transparent pricing
benefits.b2.text: Your price is locked in when you order. Later exchange-rate changes never alter an existing order.
benefits.b3.title: Clear order tracking
benefits.b3.text: A live progress bar shows exactly where your order stands.
benefits.b4.title: Your language, your currency
benefits.b4.text: The whole site is available in 20 languages with local number and date formats.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I pay on the website?
faq.a1: No. You confirm your order here, then arrange payment directly with the administrator on WhatsApp. Opening WhatsApp does not count as a payment.
faq.a2: Payments are checked manually, so it depends on the administrator's availability. Your order page always shows the current status.
faq.a3: Prices shown in a currency other than the package's own may be an estimated conversion. The amount payable is confirmed with you before you pay.
faq.a4: You can request a refund from your order page. See the refund policy for the conditions.
faq.q5: Do you ever ask for my passwords or codes?
faq.a5: Never. We do not ask for passwords, one-time codes, recovery codes or any login details for any service.
